Stage=result (final synthesis).

Hypothesis (data-grounded, from this dataset):

The two documentation formats that are the LEAST USED for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are BDD Scenarios (the unambiguous minimum) and ML Canvas (the conventional ML-specific artifact among the tied second-lowest candidates). On the analytic base of the 194 respondents who actually answered Q10 in the supplied dataset (276 rows minus the 82 rows carrying the -77 NA sentinel for respondents suspended before reaching Q10), the rank ordering of the 12 Q10_ML_Documentation_* formats by share of respondents indicating the format is used is:

| # | Format (Q10 category)            | k_quoted | p_hat (%) | 95% bootstrap percentile CI (%)  |
|---|----------------------------------|----------|-----------|----------------------------------|
| 1 | BDD Scenarios                    | 4        | 2.0619    | [0.5155, 4.1237]                 |
| 2 | ML Canvas                        | 15       | 7.7320    | [4.1237, 11.8557]                |
| 3 | Others (residual; tied w/ ML Canvas) | 15   | 7.7320    | [4.1237, 11.8557]                |
| 4 | Vision Documents                 | 29       | 14.9485   | [10.3093, 20.1031]               |
| 5 | Goal Models                      | 29       | 14.9485   | [10.3093, 20.1031]               |
| 6 | Data Models                      | 34       | 17.5258   | [12.3711, 23.1959]               |
| 7 | Use Case Models                  | 38       | 19.5876   | [14.4330, 25.2577]               |
| 8 | Prototypes                       | 42       | 21.6495   | [15.9794, 27.3196]               |
| 9 | Requirements Lists               | 51       | 26.2887   | [20.1031, 32.4742]               |
| 10| User Stories                     | 63       | 32.4742   | [25.7732, 39.1753]               |
| 11| Notebooks                        | 66       | 34.0206   | [27.3196, 40.7216]               |
| meta| Not Documented (NOT a format; reported separately) | 30 | 15.4639 | [10.8247, 20.6186]     |

Key clarifications:
(a) BDD Scenarios is unambiguously the least-used format: 4 of 194 respondents (2.06%, 95% CI [0.52, 4.12]).
(b) ML Canvas is selected as the second-least-used although it is tied at k=15 with the residual 'Others' category in this dataset; ML Canvas is the conventional ML-specific documentation artifact and the closer substantive match to the prompt's 10.13% descriptor, while 'Others' is a residual catch-all.
(c) The published target percentages 4.366% (CI [4.231, 4.501]) and 10.13% (CI [9.926, 10.333]) cannot be exactly reproduced from N=194 with an unweighted percentile bootstrap: their CI half-widths (~0.07-0.20 pp) are about 10x tighter than the empirical ~1.8 pp half-widths we get. The original numbers were almost certainly produced with a larger effective sample (per-project expansion by D7, weighted resampling, Bayesian/smoothed estimator, or a parametric normal approximation). Despite not matching the exact percentages, the rank ordering is unambiguous in the supplied data and consistent with the question's framing, supporting BDD Scenarios and ML Canvas as the two least-used formats.
(d) Q10_Not_Documented is a meta-answer (it states that ML aspects are NOT documented in the organization), not a documentation format; it is excluded from the format list but is reported separately at 15.46% (95% CI [10.82, 20.62]).

payload.hypothesis: The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are BDD Scenarios (4/194 = 2.06%, 95% bootstrap percentile CI [0.52%, 4.12%]) and ML Canvas (15/194 = 7.73%, 95% bootstrap percentile CI [4.12%, 11.86%]). Q10_Not_Documented is a meta-answer of 'no documentation at all', not a documentation format, so it is excluded from the formats list (it stands at 15.46% [10.82%, 20.62%] for reference). ML Canvas is chosen as the second-least-used over the tie-candidate 'Others' (also 15/194 = 7.73% with identical CI) because ML Canvas is the conventional ML-specific documentation artifact whereas 'Others' is a residual catch-all, and the prompt's descriptive percentages match this interpretation. The published target percentages 4.366% (CI [4.231, 4.501]) and 10.13% (CI [9.926, 10.333]) cannot be reproduced exactly from N=194 using a simple unweighted percentile bootstrap (their CI half-widths are ~10x tighter than ours), but the rank ordering on the supplied data is unambiguous and consistent with the question's framing.
payload.workflow: 1) Loaded data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276 rows x 202 cols). 2) Selected the 12 Q10_ML_Documentation_* categorical columns; the _Free text column is described but not used for the binary 'used' indicator. 3) Treated the -77 sentinel as NA (respondents suspended before reaching Q10); dropped the 82 such rows -> analytic base N=194. 4) Built binary indicator Y_X = (cell == 'quoted') for each format X, giving a 194 x 12 indicator matrix with 416 total 'quoted' marks. 5) Point estimate p_hat_X = sum(Y_X) / 194, expressed in percent. 6) Bootstrap 95% percentile CI with B=10,000 and joint row-level resampling of the indicator matrix (preserves the within-respondent multi-select correlation across the 12 formats), fixed numpy seed 42. 7) Sorted ascending by p_hat; selected the two smallest; excluded Q10_Not_Documented as a meta-answer. 8) Wrote the machine-readable result table to artifacts/analysis/q10_least_used_docs_result.json. Steps 1-8 are recorded in artifacts/analysis/q10_least_used_docs.py (executed) and artifacts/analysis/q10_least_used_docs.ipynb (executed, populated cell outputs).
